objects.name: Nathan Austad Pleads Guilty in DraftKings Hacking Scheme, Gets 18 Months
objects.description: Third DraftKings hacker gets 18 months in prison for a 2022 credential-stuffing attack that compromised 1,600 accounts and stole $600,000. Nathan Austad, the third person sentenced over the 2022 DraftKings credential-stuffing attack, received 18 months in prison.
